description: Source code implementing a Serial Wire Output (SWO) backend for logging in Zephyr RTOS, specific to ARM architecture. It initializes hardware registers, manages log output, and configures SWO parameters.

methods.name: char_out
methods.description: Outputs data bytes to the ITM stimulus port using ITM_SendChar.

methods.name: log_backend_swo_process
methods.description: Processes log messages and outputs formatted logs via the SWO backend.

methods.name: format_set
methods.description: Sets the current log format type.

methods.name: log_backend_swo_init
methods.description: Initializes the SWO logging backend, configuring hardware registers and pin control.
